scenes.title: Key ideas
items: Measure funding over time, not today. Use a 7- and 30-day average.
scenes.vo: Perpetual futures pay funding between longs and shorts to keep the perp near spot. In bullish markets longs usually pay shorts. Long spot + short perp at the same size = no net price exposure, while collecting funding. Professional rules: Measure funding over time, not today. Use a 7- and 30-day average. Exit rule: close when the 7-day average turns negative (you'd start paying). Margin buffer: the short leg's leverage decides how big a rally it survives. Venue limits: split across venues; cap each one.
scenes.cap: Measure funding over time, not today. Use a 7- and 30-day average. Exit rule: close when the 7-day average turns negative (you'd start paying). Margin buffer: the short leg's leverage decides how big a rally it survives. Venue limits: split across venues; cap each one.
